')!important}
.bf38-human-teams .celeste .bf38-portrait{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')!important}
.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot strong{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,26px)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;color:#fff!important}
.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot:hover,.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe07b!important;outline-offset:2px!important;border-color:#38d6ff!important;filter:brightness(1.08)!important}
@media(max-width:670px){.bf38-human-teams{gap:9px!important;padding:9px!important}.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot{min-height:190px!important}.bf38-human-teams .bf38-portrait{width:100%!important}}
/* V38 ajuste final: retratos grandes y tarjetas proporcionadas, sin vacíos. */
.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot,.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot.red,.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot.celeste{
 height:clamp(305px,46vh,445px)!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:445px!important;align-self:start!important;
}
.bf38-human-teams .bf38-portrait{width:min(84%,292px)!important}
@media(max-width:670px){.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot,.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot.red,.bf38-human-teams .bf24-team-hotspot.celeste{height:255px!important;min-height:0!important}.bf38-human-teams .bf38-portrait{width:96%!important}}

/* V43: remaquetación del festival. Antes, el contenido de cada tarjeta
   superaba su altura y overflow:hidden recortaba los personajes. */
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-grid{
 display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
 gap:12px!important;flex:0 0 auto!important;align-items:stretch!important;
 align-content:start!important;grid-auto-rows:minmax(204px,auto)!important;min-height:0!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:nth-child(n){
 display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.12fr) minmax(0,.9fr)!important;
 grid-template-rows:37px minmax(137px,1fr) 27px!important;
 grid-column:auto!important;gap:0!important;min-width:0!important;
 min-height:204px!important;height:100%!important;max-height:none!important;
 box-sizing:border-box!important;overflow:hidden!important;text-align:left!important;
 background:#e7f4ff!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;
 border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-top{
 grid-column:1/-1!important;grid-row:1!important;height:37px!important;min-height:0!important;
 display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;
 padding:0 9px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-text{
 grid-column:1!important;grid-row:2!important;display:flex!important;
 align-items:center!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;min-width:0!important;
 width:100%!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;
 font-size:clamp(12px,.92vw,14px)!important;line-height:1.35!important;
 padding:7px 10px!important;margin:0!important;overflow-wrap:break-word!important;
 background:#e9f3fe!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf37-card-art.bf25-post-visual{
 grid-column:2!important;grid-row:2!important;display:block!important;
 width:100%!important;height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;
 padding:0!important;margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;
 background-color:#173a76!important;background-size:contain!important;
 background-position:center!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;
 border:0!important;border-left:2px solid #73b7db!important;box-shadow:none!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-bottom{
 grid-column:1/-1!important;grid-row:3!important;display:flex!important;
 justify-content:space-around!important;align-items:center!important;
 padding:1px 10px!important;margin:0!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;
 height:27px!important;min-height:0!important;border-top:2px solid #b8ccdf!important;
 background:#e1effd!important;
}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:hover,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:focus-visible,
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post.selected{
 border-color:var(--bf-cyan)!important;transform:none!important;
 box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #01102e!important;
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;grid-auto-rows:minmax(195px,auto)!important;}
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:nth-child(n){
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  grid-template-rows:34px minmax(132px,1fr) 26px!important;min-height:195px!important;
 }
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-text{font-size:clamp(12px,1.55vw,16px)!important;}
}
@media(max-width:540px){
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:nth-child(n){
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  grid-template-rows:35px auto minmax(115px,auto) 26px!important;
  height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;
 }
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-text{
  grid-column:1!important;grid-row:2!important;min-height:55px!important;
  font-size:13px!important;line-height:1.4!important;padding:10px!important;
 }
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf37-card-art.bf25-post-visual{
  grid-column:1!important;grid-row:3!important;aspect-ratio:576 / 222!important;
  height:auto!important;min-height:115px!important;border-left:0!important;
  border-top:2px solid #73b7db!important;
 }
 .bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post-bottom{grid-column:1!important;grid-row:4!important;}
}
/* El botón de continuar no debe quedarse oculto bajo las cuatro tarjetas. */
.bf43-choose-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:0 0 auto!important;}
.bf43-choose-header .bf25-story-prompt{flex:1 1 440px!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important;text-align:left!important;}
.bf43-choose-header .bf43-choose-continue{flex:0 0 auto!important;margin:0!important;min-width:140px!important;padding:10px 13px!important;}
@media(max-width:540px){.bf43-choose-header .bf25-story-prompt{flex-basis:100%!important}.bf43-choose-header .bf43-choose-continue{margin-left:auto!important}}


/* V32 · receiver.css */
/* Receptor y cierre: mismo marco, la misma barra, mismos pixel-icons y tipografía. */
.bfmvp-receiver{height:100dvh!important;min-height:100dvh!important;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bf-bg)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.bfmvp-receiver-header{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.bfmvp-receiver-ticker{display:flex;gap:24px;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden}
.bfmvp-receiver-ticker span{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;border-right:2px solid var(--bf-cyan-dark)!important;padding-right:24px!important}
.bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2.08fr) minmax(285px,1fr)!important;gap:clamp(11px,1.2vw,19px)!important;
 padding:clamp(10px,1.3vw,17px)!important;max-width:1850px!important}
.bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfmvp-guide{border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:var(--bf-shadow)!important}
.bfmvp-guide-inner{padding:18px!important;display:grid;gap:14px!important;align-content:start}
.bfmvp-guide-title{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
.bfmvp-guide-line p{font-size:clamp(13px,.97vw,16px)!important}
.bfmvp-guide-result{background:#10386e!important;padding:14px!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.bfmvp-guide-result span{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
.bfmvp-case-box{background:#0a3167!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:13px!important}
.bfmvp-case-box p{margin:10px 0!important}
.bfmvp-mission{background:var(--bf-panel)!important;gap:clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px)!important;padding:clamp(18px,2vw,30px)!important}
.bfmvp-pixel-eyebrow,.bfmvp-quest,.bfmvp-tweet-top,.bfmvp-tweet-copy,.bfmvp-after-answer,
.bfmvp-end-banner p,.bfmvp-end-note,.bfmvp-final-prompt p,.bfmvp-details,.bfmvp-clue{
 font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;
}
.bfmvp-mission-top h1{font-size:clamp(21px,2.1vw,31px)!important;line-height:1.2!important}
.bfmvp-mission-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(290px,.95fr)!important;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,24px)!important}
.bfmvp-tweet{background:#eaf4ff!important;border-radius:0!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #010e30!important;overflow:hidden!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important}
.bfmvp-tweet-top{background:#103c7d!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;gap:8px;font-size:clamp(11px,.84vw,14px)!important;padding:10px 13px!important}
.bfmvp-tweet-copy{font-size:clamp(14px,1.2vw,19px)!important;line-height:1.37!important;padding:15px!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;font-weight:850!important}
.bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{border-top:2px solid #1f92c0!important;aspect-ratio:1.7/1!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important}
.bfmvp-tweet-actions{border-top:2px solid #c6d8e9!important;padding:7px 13px!important;gap:16px!important;justify-content:space-around!important}
.bfmvp-play-side{gap:10px!important}
.bfmvp-quest{font-size:clamp(15px,1.15vw,19px)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.bfmvp-choice-group{gap:9px!important}
.bfmvp-choice{background:#0d3978!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;border-radius:0!important;
 min-height:49px!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.01vw,15px)!important;font-weight:800!important;padding:10px 12px!important}
.bfmvp-choice .bfpx-icon{width:21px;height:21px}
.bfmvp-choice:hover,.bfmvp-choice:focus-visible{background:#10518b!important;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bfmvp-choice.is-chosen{background:#185385!important;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bfmvp-choice:disabled{opacity:.8!important}
.bfmvp-inspect{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;background:#0d3266!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;color:#e4f8ff!important;
 padding:10px 13px!important;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px!important;min-height:42px}
.bfmvp-inspect:hover{background:#12528c!important}
.bfmvp-clue{background:#143e73!important;color:#e8f6ff!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;padding:12px 14px!important;font-size:13px!important}
.bfmvp-after-answer{background:#0c346b!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-success)!important;padding:11px!important;gap:12px!important}
.bfmvp-after-answer span{color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.bfmvp-after-answer button{background:#0b7dcc!important;white-space:normal!important}
.bfmvp-storage-warning{background:#49352c!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:8px 12px!important}
.bfmvp-timer{background:#28224e!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-pink)!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #081234!important;border-radius:0!important}
.bfmvp-timer span,.bfmvp-timer strong,.bfmvp-timer button{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.bfmvp-timer button{border:2px solid var(--bf-pink)!important}
.bfmvp-end{background:var(--bf-panel)!important;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,42px)!important;gap:20px!important}
.bfmvp-end-banner{background:#0d3166!important;padding:15px!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bfmvp-end-banner .bfmvp-art{border-radius:0!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #010f30!important}
.bfmvp-end-banner h1{font-size:clamp(19px,2.25vw,32px)!important}
.bfmvp-end-banner p{font-size:clamp(13px,1.05vw,17px)!important}
.bfmvp-final-prompt{background:#0f3976!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bfmvp-skill-tag{border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:2px 2px 0 #010e2a!important}
.bfmvp-final-prompt strong{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bfmvp-details{border-top:2px solid #1a669d!important;padding-top:13px!important;font-size:12px!important}
.bfmvp-receiver-status{display:none!important} /* No mostrar etiquetas técnicas 'MODO RECEPTOR'. */
/* Decisión de empatía: nunca botones grises del navegador. */
.bfmvp-kindness-choices{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:13px}
.bfmvp-kindness-choice{width:100%;display:block;min-height:43px;text-align:left;padding:10px 13px;
 background:#103c7d;color:var(--bf-white);border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan);border-radius:0;
 box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #02122e;line-height:1.35;font-family:var(--bf-font-body);font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.bfmvp-kindness-choice:hover:not(:disabled),.bfmvp-kindness-choice:focus-visible{background:#145b98;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)}
.bfmvp-kindness-choice.is-selected{background:#124f80;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)}
.bfmvp-kindness-choice:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.77}
.bfmvp-kindness-feedback{border-left:3px solid var(--bf-success);background:#0d3268;padding:11px;color:var(--bf-white);line-height:1.4}
.bfmvp-mission-instruction strong{display:block;color:var(--bf-white);font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(14px,1.17vw,19px)}
.bfmvp-mission-instruction p{color:var(--bf-muted);font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,16px);line-height:1.45;margin:8px 0}
.bfmvp-guide-result p,.bfmvp-case-box p{font-size:inherit!important}


/* V32 · peer.css */
/* BLOCK FACE V40 · reto individual pixel art. Publicación grande, no barras de dashboard. */
.bfpeer{height:auto!important;min-height:100dvh!important;overflow:visible!important}
.bfpeer .bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(235px, .29fr)!important;gap:12px!important;align-items:start!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important}
.bfpeer .bfmvp-receiver-play{overflow:visible!important;min-height:0!important;height:auto!important}
.bfpeer .bfmvp-guide{height:auto!important;min-height:220px!important}
.bfpeer-stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:clamp(13px,1.7vw,24px);gap:13px;min-width:0}
.bfpeer-intro{display:grid;gap:5px}
.bfpeer-intro h1{color:var(--bf-cyan);font:900 clamp(22px,2vw,30px)/1.2 var(--bf-font-display);margin:0}
.bfpeer-intro p{font:750 clamp(13px,1.08vw,16px)/1.38 var(--bf-font-body);margin:0;color:var(--bf-white)}
.bfpeer-tweet{width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:none;background:#eaf4ff;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan);box-shadow:4px 4px #010e2d;color:var(--bf-ink)}
.bfpeer-post-heading{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;background:#103c7d;color:#f4f8ff;font:800 clamp(11px,.95vw,14px) var(--bf-font-display);padding:9px 12px}
.bfpeer-post-heading>span:last-child{margin-left:auto}
.bfpeer-tweet>p{font:850 clamp(14px,1.08vw,17px)/1.4 var(--bf-font-body);padding:11px 13px;margin:0}
.bfpeer-scene{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;max-height:none;min-height:0;background-size:100% 100%!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-position:center!important;background-color:#133765!important;border-top:3px solid var(--bf-cyan);image-rendering:pixelated}

.bfpeer-scene.peer_02_contexto,.bfpeer-evidence-thumb.peer_02_contexto{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,')!important}
.bfpeer-scene.peer_03_sensacionalismo,.bfpeer-evidence-thumb.peer_03_sensacionalismo{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,
